target: measured drain current between three disclosed gate-voltage calibration anchors
timing_contract: offline sparse-characterization task: three responses at -20,0,20 V are obtained before reconstructing other gate points; not an uncalibrated or causal sweep forecast
calibration: Exactly three same-device current measurements at Vg=-20,0,20 V; all models see the same anchors; those points excluded from scores.
scope_limits: 36 fabricated FET curves from source Fig2e, not independent lots; no memory-retention extrapolation, no device-geometry control or interventions.

exposure.internal_confirmation: held out until frozen model/stop selection

uncertainty_policy: Individual group errors; empirical group range, no row bootstrap or population CI.

aggregation.weights: equal group then equal eligible row

training_scope: See each state training_scope; complete development groups only.
outcome_cohort: reserved groups recorded in SPLITS.json; no calibration anchors scored.
